verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a terminal client, for example broadcasting input to many sessions or acting on many hosts or files at once. Nothing in the pack documents Blink offering a bulk-action capability. Individual commands (cp, rm, mv) and small python/lua scripts are developer building blocks a user could use to build bulk workflows, not a first-party bulk-operations feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
